owner_facing_goal: Add a two-handed long spear as the first weapon built on the 0.28.0 combat data infrastructure: a diamond-tier SwordItem with spear attributes whose cultivation combat comes entirely from data (myvillage:basic_spear), with mapped vanilla behavior in vanilla mode.

creative_tab.ordering: Immediately after myvillage:qingxiao_liuyun_sword and before myvillage:low_grade_spirit_stone.

behavior.server_client_boundary: In vanilla mode the item follows the Minecraft SwordItem path; CombatWeaponItem only keeps a durability-only stack change from replaying the equip animation. In cultivation mode the combat runtime finds the item through data/myvillage/combat/weapon/lingxiao_spear.json; no Java code names the item, and the server owns mode, move, timing, hit volume, targets, damage, step movement, recovery, and synchronization exactly as for other data-registered weapons.
behavior.interaction: Mapped vanilla left-click attack/mining outside cultivation mode; the five myvillage:basic_spear moves inside it. No right-click behavior.
behavior.cooldown_or_durability: Diamond-tier durability 1561 and max stack size 1 from the tier. Held attack damage 8.0 and attack speed 1.2 (SwordItem.createAttributes(Tiers.DIAMOND, 4, -2.8F)). Cultivation timing is move-owned by the style data.
data_components: No item-owned combo or mode component
tests: Registration as CombatWeaponItem, attributes, creative-tab ordering, bilingual names, and swords-tag membership match this contract (tools/validate_mod_items.py)
The item model is a neoforge:separate_transforms wrapper over myvillage:item/lingxiao_spear_3d whose gui perspective stays the 2D myvillage:item/lingxiao_spear icon
No Java source under combat/** or client/combat/** names the item

jar_checks: item.myvillage.lingxiao_spear is present in assets/myvillage/lang/en_us.json and assets/myvillage/lang/zh_cn.json

non_goals: Crafting recipe, loot acquisition, natural generation, or advancement hook
Any Java hook that names the item outside ModItems
Off-hand item placement; the spear stays a main-hand item drawn with two hands
New sound assets, projectiles, special arts, or spiritual-power cost
